items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: And Bebe Ridgely, I shook hands with him at Piku's funeral.

ctx.x: What was it? I saw him about a month ago. I haven't seen him for about a month.
And Bebe Ridgely, I shook hands with him at Piku's funeral.

Yeah, I didn't see him. I was there at the funeral, but I didn't see him. They had a picture of him in the paper there. And he died about a month, a couple months later, too. Yeah. Did you ever work with Bebe? I guess you did. With Bebe. Bebe Ridgely?
